channel.title: Paksh: Crime & Law
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Larry Nassar Not Removed From Michigan Sex Offender Registry
item.description: Michigan state police have ruled out claims that Larry Nassar was removed from the state's sex offender registry. The Eaton County prosecuting attorney's office had stated that a court ruling forced the removal of Nassar's name, but he was… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: 49ers Owner Jed York Suspended After Prostitution Arrest
item.description: Jed York, owner of the NFL's San Francisco 49ers, has been suspended for six games and fined by the league following his arrest in a prostitution sting. The suspension is reportedly tied to a violation of the NFL's conduct policy. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: Man City Leaks Whistleblower Rui Pinto Faces Abandonment Amid Threats
item.description: Rui Pinto, the whistleblower responsible for leaking documents related to Manchester City, is reportedly facing the withdrawal of witness protection by Portuguese authorities. Pinto, who provided information that led to investigations into… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 0 · Right 0.

item.title: Police use street sports to combat youth crime and loneliness
item.description: Law enforcement agencies are utilizing street sports programs as a strategy to address rising youth crime and feelings of loneliness. These initiatives are presented as an "entry point" to engage young people and offer solutions to these… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Judge Blocks Border Wall Construction in Texas National Park
item.description: A federal judge has temporarily blocked the Trump administration from restarting border wall construction in the Big Bend region of Texas. The order specifically halts work in a national park. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Kratom Sales Linked to Student Deaths: Clerk and Son Charged
item.description: A shop clerk and his son have been charged by federal prosecutors with selling illegal kratom, which is being investigated for its potential connection to the deaths of two University of Mississippi students. The charges stem from an… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: US Justice Department Declines to Reopen Powell Investigation
item.description: The U.S. Justice Department has decided not to reopen a criminal investigation into former Federal Reserve chair Jerome Powell. The investigation was related to cost overruns concerning the central bank's building renovation project. This… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: US death penalty history marked by 'extraordinary' Pike case
item.description: Legal scholar Austin Sarat has described the Pike case as an 'extraordinary and unprecedented moment' in the history of the US death penalty. Coverage from The Globe and Mail frames the death penalty itself as 'always cruel and unusual'. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Five Foreign Nationals Arrested in British Columbia Extortion Probe
item.description: Royal Canadian Mounted Police (RCMP) in British Columbia have arrested five foreign nationals in connection with an extortion investigation. The arrests are tied to extortion and other crimes. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: NY Governor Vows to Close 'Intoxication Loophole' After Cornell Assault
item.description: New York Governor Kathy Hochul has pledged to close an "intoxication loophole" in state law following an assault case at Cornell University. The case has brought renewed scrutiny to a little-known New York law concerning intoxicated… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Manchester City found guilty of financial rule breaches
item.description: Manchester City has been found guilty by an independent commission of financial rule-breaking in the Premier League. Following the verdict, Emirati officials reportedly warned the UK government that the UAE might halt investments in the… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: Flydubai Co-Pilot Attacker Identified, Barred by Oman
item.description: The co-pilot who attacked a Flydubai flight has been identified. He had previously been barred from flying by Oman due to radical views. The attacker's identity and the reasons for his ban by Oman were reported. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: DOJ Asks Court to Uphold Trump's Ban on CNN, MS Now, Politico
item.description: The U.S. Department of Justice (DOJ) has asked a court to uphold a ban previously imposed by the Trump White House on CNN, MS Now, and Politico. The DOJ is defending the ban, seeking its reinstatement. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: Former US Congressman David Rivera Sentenced to 10 Years in Prison
item.description: Former Florida congressman David Rivera has been sentenced to 10 years in prison for his involvement in a $50 million Venezuela lobbying case. Rivera, described as a longtime friend of US Secretary of State Marco Rubio, was convicted in… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: California Man Arrested for Alleged $300 Million Chip Smuggling to China
item.description: Federal prosecutors have arrested a California man, identified as Greg Lui, 38, for allegedly orchestrating a scheme to smuggle over $300 million worth of export-controlled computer servers containing US-made graphics processing units… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Cornell Rape Accuser Describes Feeling 'Like Bait' Amid Online Scrutiny
item.description: A woman identified as Jane Doe, who accused a Cornell University fraternity of rape, told investigators she felt "like bait" with "lions around me." Her attorney stated she was "incapable of consent" and accused Cornell of a "cover-up."… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: Man Charged with Terror Plot Against Nigel Farage
item.description: A 28-year-old British man has been charged with preparing acts of terrorism against Nigel Farage, a UK far-right leader. The suspect is also reportedly a murder suspect in the Ann Widdecombe case. The charges relate to a suspected terror… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: Air ambulance with 6 aboard vanishes off US coast, search underway
item.description: An air ambulance carrying six people has vanished off the coast of Nantucket, Massachusetts, prompting a search by the U.S. Coast Guard. The aircraft, which was en route from Bermuda to Boston, lost communication with flight controllers… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 6 · Right 0.

item.title: Cyber fraud cases reported across India
item.description: Multiple reports detail cyber fraud incidents across India. In one case, a judicial institution employee's account was hacked, leading to a loss of ₹99,000, and police have registered a case. Separately, in Bhind, eight individuals… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Karnataka Tells Supreme Court No Devadasi Dedication System Exists
item.description: The Karnataka government informed the Supreme Court that there is no present or ongoing system of Devadasi dedication in the state. This statement was made in response to a matter before the court concerning the practice. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Lawyers Body Forms Inquiry Commission on Election Commission's Special Intensive Review
item.description: A lawyers' body has formed a five-judge inquiry commission to investigate the Election Commission of India's Special Intensive Review (SIR). The commission is scheduled to submit its report by December. The Lawyers Association for… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: Actors Jr NTR and Janhvi Kapoor Condemn AI-Generated Deepfake Video
item.description: Actors Jr NTR and Janhvi Kapoor have condemned a vulgar artificial intelligence (AI) generated deepfake video featuring Janhvi Kapoor, reportedly set to the "Chuttamalle" song. Both actors have vowed to take legal action against the misuse… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: Delhi High Court: Father-in-law not liable for son's actions under DV Act
item.description: The Delhi High Court has ruled that a father-in-law cannot be held liable under the Domestic Violence Act for failing to control his adult son. The court clarified that the act does not impose a duty on a father-in-law to control the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Attack on Kuwaiti tanker in Strait of Hormuz, 5 Indian sailors rescued
item.description: A Kuwaiti oil tanker was attacked in the Strait of Hormuz, with five Indian sailors on board being rescued with the help of Oman. The incident saw a missile strike on the tanker, reigniting tensions in the region. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Five Indian-origin men arrested in Canada for extortion and related charges
item.description: Five men of Indian origin have been arrested in Canada in connection with an extortion probe that also involves shootings, arson, and firearms charges. The arrests are linked to an investigation targeting an auto dealership. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Mallya Owes ₹8,752 Crore to SBI-Led Banks, Lenders Tell Bombay HC
item.description: A consortium of banks, led by the State Bank of India (SBI), informed the Bombay High Court that Vijay Mallya owes them ₹8,751.86 crore. This statement was made in response to Mallya's claim that the lenders had recovered more than his… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Army hands over girl to police after LoC crossing
item.description: The Indian Army has handed over a 17-year-old girl to the police after she crossed the Line of Control (LoC) in Rajouri, Jammu and Kashmir. The incident occurred in the Nowshera sector of Rajouri. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Parliamentary panel may recommend action on crypto monitoring
item.description: A parliamentary panel is considering recommending government action regarding the monitoring of cryptocurrencies. The panel's potential recommendations are focused on how to oversee the digital currency landscape. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: NHRC Probes Use of Minors in Mumbai Protest
item.description: The National Human Rights Commission (NHRC) has taken cognizance of reports alleging the use of minor children as a shield during an illegal protest in Mumbai. The NHRC has ordered a probe into the matter and is seeking Action Taken… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Bitchat App Removed from India's Apple App Store
item.description: The Bitchat application has been removed from the Apple App Store in India following an order from the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY). Apple cited the MeitY order as the reason for the app's disappearance… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Gurugram Man Dies After Fall From Noida High-Rise; Police Investigate Financial Distress
item.description: A man from Gurugram died after falling from the 43rd floor of a high-rise building in Noida. Police are investigating the incident, with a focus on the possibility of financial distress as a motive. The man had reportedly checked into an… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: FSSAI finds Nestle dairy whitener unsafe, orders halt to sales
item.description: The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) has declared a sample of Nestle's low-fat dairy whitener, collected at Hotel Lalit, as "unsafe." Following this finding, FSSAI has ordered an immediate halt to the sales of the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Parineeti Chopra Investigates Illegal Sand Mining in New Report
item.description: Actress Parineeti Chopra has taken on the role of a reporter to investigate and expose illegal sand mining operations. A trailer for a "Reporting Live" segment featuring Chopra's investigation has been released, highlighting her efforts to… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 0 · Right 2.

item.title: Man Dies After Falling From 43rd Floor in Noida
item.description: A man died after jumping from the 43rd floor of a building in Noida's Supernova Society. His body was found in multiple pieces at the scene. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Two Iranians Charged in UK Over Alleged Terror Plot Targeting Jewish Community
item.description: Two Iranian nationals have been charged in the United Kingdom in connection with an alleged terrorism plot targeting the Jewish community. Police accused the two men of planning an attack, with one report specifying the alleged plot was… Coverage: Left 3 · Centre 5 · Right 1.

item.title: Boiler explosion at Andhra Pradesh pharma factory kills workers
item.description: A boiler explosion occurred at a pharmaceutical factory in Tirupati, Andhra Pradesh, resulting in the deaths of at least four workers and injuring more than ten others. Reports indicate that five employees died and over ten were injured in… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: Car crashes into crowd in Australia, injuring 10
item.description: A car crashed into a crowd of rugby fans north of Sydney, Australia, injuring 10 people. Two individuals were reported to be in critical condition: a five-year-old girl and a 67-year-old man. The incident occurred near Newcastle, involving… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 9 · Right 0.

item.title: Indian Pilot Smit Machchhar Recovers After Mid-Air Stabbing
item.description: Captain Smit Machchhar, an Indian pilot for flydubai, is recovering well after a mid-air stabbing attack on an Israel-bound flight. The incident, which occurred on flight FZ1073, involved an attack from within the cockpit. Machchhar's… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Woman Allegedly Assaulted, Stripped at Guwahati Nightclub; Manager, Others Arrested
item.description: A woman was allegedly assaulted and stripped by bouncers at a nightclub in Guwahati. A video of the incident has emerged. Police have filed a suo motu case and arrested seven people, including the club manager. The club was reportedly open… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 1.

item.title: Five Indian Seafarers Rescued After Tanker Hit by Projectile
item.description: Five Indian nationals were rescued after the Kuwait-flagged tanker MT Kazimah III was struck by a projectile in the Strait of Hormuz. The Indian Embassy in Oman coordinated the rescue of the seafarers, who were brought ashore safely in… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 2.
